parameters.packNote: One call returned 64 candidates (review object bb862549-d680-4547-a4a2-9b6380b5f89a, tagged heat, weapon, bow, rejected); the owner picked 0 from a numbered sheet at 3x. Every candidate came out on the diagonal, string from the lower left to the upper right, although each description asked for an upright bow: the style image is a diagonal icon.

icon.from: the object's one rotation, the bow on the diagonal; the weapon's icon in the inventory, and not a frame of its swing

swing.animationDescription: an upright wooden bow is drawn and loosed: the thick brown wooden stave on the right keeps its size, its thickness and its curve and stays in place the whole time; only the thin string on the left moves: its middle is pulled smoothly back to the left, a little further each frame, into a V; then it snaps straight again; the same bow the whole time, no arrow, no particles, no effects, no motion trail

startFrame.from: frame 3 of the first swing made for this bow (listed under replaced), the bow standing upright with its string straight; passed as custom_start_frame_base64, so swing-0.png is that frame and not the icon

endFrame.from: the same picture as the start frame, passed as end_frame_base64, so the bow ends at rest where it began

swing.holdFrameNote: The bow at rest just after the release, so that the arrow leaves as the hold begins (agreed with the owner 2026-11-10). The string is furthest back on frame 3.
swing.nocksNote: The pixel at the middle of the string on every frame, measured on a grid as the grips are: where an arrow's tail sits while the bow is drawn. No arrow is drawn in these frames.
swing.playing: The owner's notes for whatever plays it (2026-11-10): skip a frame of the release, or play that end faster, frames 4 and 5; and show the arrow's sprite (art/effects/arrow-01, part-projectile.png) on the bow while it is drawn, its tail on the nock.

replaced.description: a bow being shot to the right: the bow is raised until it stands upright, its wooden stave on the right and its string on the left; the middle of the string is pulled back to the left into a sharp V until the bow is fully drawn; then the string snaps straight again; the same bow the whole time, no arrow, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: Began at the icon and rose upright by frame 3, then drew an arrow on the string that never left, and never pulled the string back. Its frame 3 is the start and end frame of the kept swing. Its frames are no longer in PixelLab: the next one was made over it.

replaced.description: a bow being shot to the right: the bow is raised until it stands upright, its wooden stave on the right and its string on the left; the middle of the string is pulled back to the left into a sharp V with an arrow on it; then the arrow is gone and the string is straight again; the last frame is the empty upright bow with a straight string and no arrow; the same bow the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: Made again in the same group (replace_existing): the bow never stood upright, bent out of shape and shed pieces of an arrow.

replaced.description: an upright bow is drawn and loosed: the bow stays upright and in place; the middle of its string is pulled back to the left into a sharp V and the bow's limbs bend; then the string snaps straight again and the bow is at rest; the same bow the whole time, no arrow, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: The first with the upright start and end frames: it drew and loosed in five frames, and the owner did not keep it ("the bow isn't great").

replaced.description: an archer's upright wooden bow shoots to the right: the thick brown stave on the right keeps its size and thickness and stays in place; an arrow is laid across the bow pointing right and the string is pulled back to the left with it into a V until the bow is fully drawn; then the arrow has flown and is gone, and the string is straight again on the empty bow; the same bow the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: Made beside the kept swing with an arrow drawn on the string; the owner kept the one without, the arrow being a sprite of its own.

verified: Every PNG here is byte-identical to the same file in PixelLab's own export of the object, downloaded 2026-11-11.
